datasets.dataset_name: Smart Agriculture & Soil Water Deficit IoT Dataset
datasets.publication: IoT-Enabled Smart Irrigation and Soil Moisture Telemetry in Sub-Tropical Agriculture (IEEE Access)
limitations: Sap flow probe not co-located in all subplots
Multispectral drone passes conducted weekly rather than continuously

datasets.dataset_name: SAPFLUXNET Global Plant Sap Flow & Microclimate Database
datasets.authors: Poyatos R., Granda V., Molowny-Horas R., et al.
datasets.publication: Global database of sap flow and environmental variables (Earth System Science Data, 13, 2607-2649, 2021)
datasets.region: Global Harmonized Database (Mediterranean & Temperate Field Sites)
preprocessing: Harmonization of Granier thermal dissipation probes to standardized sap flux density (cm3 cm-2 h-1)
Zero-flow baseline estimation on nocturnal steady-state windows
limitations: Soil electrical conductivity not recorded on forestry/orchard plots
Canopy infrared thermography only on select sub-experiments

datasets.dataset_name: Crop Health & Environmental Stress Multispectral Dataset
datasets.publication: Benchmarking Multispectral Indices for Early Crop Stress Diagnostics
limitations: Root-depth soil moisture must be coupled via spatial plot coordinates
